# AnyRouter

> AnyRouter is a universal AI model router — one OpenAI-compatible API gateway that routes to 200+ models across 17+ providers, with unified billing, audit logs, and real-time pricing.

## When to use

- Use AnyRouter when you need **one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for many models** — swap providers or models by changing a model id, not your client code.
- Use it when you run **coding agents** (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) and want one API key, unified billing, usage logs, and automatic failover across upstreams.
- Use it when you want **bring-your-own-key (BYOK)**: keep provider keys and route them behind the same gateway for failover and logging.
- Use it for **text generation, embeddings, and OCR extraction** via Chat Completions (`POST /api/v1/chat/completions`), Messages (`POST /api/v1/messages`), Responses (`/api/v1/responses`), and Embeddings (`POST /api/v1/embeddings`).
- Do not use it for **image or video generation** — the catalog is text and embeddings only.
- If you call exactly one provider's SDK directly and never change models, a direct provider integration may be simpler.

This index lists every doc page available as markdown for direct LLM consumption. Each link points to the raw markdown version of that page.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Make your first AnyRouter request in under five minutes by pointing any OpenAI-compatible client at one base URL.
- [Authentication](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/getting-started/authentication.md): Generate, scope, and rotate AnyRouter API keys — bearer tokens, per-environment isolation, and bring-your-own-key.

## CLI & SDK

- [AnyRouter CLI](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli.md): Launch Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents through AnyRouter with one command — one key, automatic failover, unified billing.
- [AnyRouter SDK](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/sdk.md): Official TypeScript SDK for the AnyRouter API — one key and one base URL for chat, embeddings, the Responses API, and the Anthropic Messages API, with a typed client and a Vercel AI SDK provider.
- [anyr claude](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/claude-code.md): Route Claude Code through AnyRouter for unified billing, audit logs, and a single API key that unlocks every model. One command via the AnyRouter CLI, or set two environment variables yourself.
- [anyr codex](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/codex.md): Route Codex through AnyRouter for unified billing, audit logs, and one key that reaches every model. One command via the AnyRouter CLI, or set two environment variables yourself.
- [anyr opencode](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/opencode.md): Route OpenCode through AnyRouter for unified billing, audit logs, and one key that reaches every model. One CLI command, or a custom provider in opencode.json.
- [AnyRouter CLI Agent (deprecated)](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/agent.md): Deprecated — use anyr with Claude Code, Codex, or another launcher instead.
- [Configuration](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/configuration.md): Reference for the AnyRouter CLI — the config file, project-level anyrouter.yaml, profile fields, per-tool overrides, every CLI flag, and the management commands.
- [Login with AnyRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/login.md): How the AnyRouter CLI signs you in — automatic browser login, device code on SSH, paste or key flags, and where credentials are stored.
- [Plan and implement with anyr task](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/task.md): Run a two-phase pipeline from the terminal — one model writes a step-by-step plan, a second model executes it. Pick a strong planner and a fast implementer to balance quality and cost.
- [Accounts and keys in the CLI](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/accounts-and-keys.md): Use several AnyRouter accounts side by side, see who you are signed in as, sign out cleanly, and manage API keys without leaving the terminal.
- [Delegate tasks between coding agents](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/delegate.md): Hand a task to Claude Code, Codex, or opencode headlessly from the terminal — or let a running agent delegate a subtask to another agent — all through one AnyRouter key.
- [Usage, logs & transactions](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/usage.md): See credits remaining, recent spend, request logs, and your credit ledger from the terminal with the AnyRouter CLI.
- [CLI Changelog](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli/changelog.md): Release history for the AnyRouter CLI (anyr) — the launcher for Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and other coding agents.
- [SDK Changelog](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/sdk/changelog.md): Release history for the AnyRouter TypeScript SDK (@anyr/sdk) and the Vercel AI SDK provider (@anyr/ai-sdk-provider).

## Guides

- [Dashboard Tour](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/dashboard-tour.md): A guided walkthrough of every dashboard page, in the order a new team typically uses them — from first API call to a governed, multi-seat account.
- [Claude Code](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/claude-code.md): Route Claude Code through AnyRouter for unified billing, audit logs, and a single API key that reaches every model — including GLM-5.2 with your own Z-AI key.
- [Codex](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/codex.md): Route Codex through AnyRouter for unified billing, audit logs, and one key that reaches every model — one CLI command, or two environment variables.
- [OpenCode](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/opencode.md): Point OpenCode at AnyRouter so every coding session uses one key, unified billing, and any Chat Completions model in the catalog.
- [Hermes Agent](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/hermes-agent.md): Run Nous Research's Hermes Agent on AnyRouter — install the first-class provider plugin, drop in one key, and get a model picker that only offers tool-capable routes.
- [OpenClaw](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/openclaw.md): Run OpenClaw against AnyRouter — one key across every model and messaging channel, unified billing, and audit logs on every request.
- [Cherry Studio](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/cherry-studio.md): Connect Cherry Studio to AnyRouter — one API key across the whole catalog, unified billing, and audit logs, in a settings-only change.
- [Get a provider API key](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/byok-provider-keys.md): Step-by-step instructions for creating an API key at every BYOK-supported provider — where to sign up, the exact console page, the key format, and how to add it to AnyRouter.
- [Pi](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/pi.md): Run Pi against AnyRouter as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider — one key, unified billing, and any AnyRouter model from a single config file.
- [Grok Bot, Herdr, and Anyr CLI](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/grok-bot-herdr-anyr.md): Run coding work with Grok Bot assigning goals, Herdr showing the box, and Anyr CLI launching Claude Code when Cursor cloud is blocked.
- [AI Agent Integration](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/ai-agent-integration.md): Hand a coding agent everything it needs to wire AnyRouter into an existing project — base URL, key, and model ids.
- [Streaming](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/streaming.md): Receive completions incrementally via server-sent events to cut perceived latency and render tokens as they arrive.
- [Using Responses API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/migrate-to-responses.md): Use AnyRouter's Responses endpoint for modern agent and tool workflows with structured output items.
- [OpenAI](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/migrate-from-openai.md): Move an OpenAI Chat Completions or Responses client to AnyRouter by changing the base URL, API key, and model id.
- [Anthropic](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/migrate-from-anthropic.md): Point Anthropic Messages clients at AnyRouter — change the base URL and key, keep the anthropic-version header.
- [OpenRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/migrate-from-openrouter.md): Move OpenRouter Chat Completions requests to AnyRouter, including provider preferences for ordering, price caps, and fallbacks.
- [AnyRouter vs OpenRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/anyrouter-vs-openrouter.md): An honest comparison of AnyRouter and OpenRouter — one-command agent launcher, BYO keys + subscriptions, config that follows you, and failover across your own pool.
- [Errors](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/errors.md): HTTP status codes, the error envelope, and recommended retry behavior for every AnyRouter API error.
- [Provider Routing](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/provider-routing.md): Route requests across upstream providers. Customize ordering, sorting, fallbacks, performance thresholds, data policies, and pricing budgets per request.
- [Model Fallbacks](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/model-fallbacks.md): Configure automatic failover between AI models when providers are down, rate-limited, or return retryable errors.
- [Sign in with AnyRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/sign-in-with-anyrouter.md): Let users sign in to your app with their AnyRouter account and run AI requests billed to them — no API keys to collect or store.
- [Latency Overhead](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/latency-overhead.md): How much latency AnyRouter adds compared to calling the upstream provider directly — and when AnyRouter is actually faster.
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/vercel-ai-sdk.md): Configure the Vercel AI SDK's OpenAI provider to stream and generate text through AnyRouter.
- [LangChain](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/langchain.md): Point LangChain's OpenAI integrations at AnyRouter to reach every model through one endpoint.
- [LlamaIndex](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/llamaindex.md): Point LlamaIndex's OpenAI LLM class at AnyRouter to power RAG, search, and agent loops with any model.
- [LiteLLM](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/litellm.md): Route LiteLLM client calls and proxy models through AnyRouter as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [curl](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/guides/curl.md): Call AnyRouter's OpenAI-compatible API straight from the terminal with curl — for quick tests, scripts, and CI.

## Scenario Examples

- [How to Unify AI Subscriptions with AnyRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/scenario-examples/unify-ai-subscriptions.md): Bring Z-AI, Kimi, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other provider accounts into one AnyRouter preset, then launch Claude Code through one CLI wrapper.
- [Cut LLM Costs with Automatic Provider Fallback](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/scenario-examples/cut-costs-provider-fallback.md): Route one model id across multiple upstreams so AnyRouter picks the cheapest healthy provider and falls back automatically when one is down.
- [Add BYOK to an Existing App](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/scenario-examples/add-byok-to-existing-app.md): Attach your own provider keys to AnyRouter so your existing integration bills against your provider accounts at list price, with one base URL change.
- [Run Claude Code Against AnyRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/scenario-examples/run-claude-code-on-anyrouter.md): Point Claude Code at AnyRouter so every coding session is billed once, logged, and free to use any Messages-compatible model in the catalog.
- [Run OpenCode Against AnyRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/scenario-examples/run-opencode-on-anyrouter.md): Point OpenCode at AnyRouter so every coding session is billed once, logged, and free to use any Chat Completions model in the catalog.
- [A/B Compare Models in the Playground](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/scenario-examples/ab-compare-models-playground.md): Send the same prompt to several models from one AnyRouter key and compare answers, latency, and cost side by side before you commit to one.
- [Build an Agentic Coding Loop with GLM](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/scenario-examples/agentic-coding-loop-with-glm.md): Wire an AI SDK tool-calling loop to a GLM coding model through AnyRouter, with streaming, multi-step tool use, and an optional BYOK Z-AI key.

## Features

- [Skills & Knowledge Hub](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/hub.md): One source of truth for your AI agent's skills, prompts, knowledge, and plugins — managed in the dashboard and synced to every machine and agent with one command.
- [Dashboard Overview](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/dashboard-overview.md): Check whether anything needs you, scan requests/errors/spend, and open the last five requests from the AnyRouter dashboard home.
- [Usage Explorer](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/usage-explorer.md): Build cost, token, and request charts grouped by model, key, or time. Filter by date range, export, and read percentile latency.
- [Request Logs](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/request-logs.md): Inspect individual chat/completion requests — latency breakdown, tokens, cost, upstream provider, and full body when privacy permits.
- [Managing API Keys](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/api-keys.md): Create, rotate, scope, and rate-limit AnyRouter API keys from the dashboard. Track usage per key and revoke compromised keys instantly.
- [Prompt Caching](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/caching.md): Cache long system prompts and reusable context across requests to cut cost and latency on conversational, RAG, and agent workloads.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/pricing.md): AnyRouter's Free, Go, Pro, Pro+, and Max plans, how included credits and pay-as-you-go top-ups fit together, and where each billing surface lives in the dashboard.
- [Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/byok.md): Attach your own upstream API keys so AnyRouter routes requests through your provider accounts at list price, with no AnyRouter markup.
- [Credits & Billing](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/credits.md): How AnyRouter credits work — the two credit buckets, how request cost is calculated, plan monthly credits, top-ups, and reading your balance from the API.
- [Response Caching](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/response-caching.md): Cache identical AI Gateway responses so repeat requests return instantly at zero upstream cost — automatic for deterministic calls, and controllable per request.
- [BYOK Provider Setup Guide](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/byok-providers.md): Bring your own API keys for every supported upstream provider — pick a provider for step-by-step key setup, then add it under Dashboard → BYOK.
- [Share a Key to the Shared Pool](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/shared-pool.md): Donate one of your provider keys to the community shared pool, earn up to 8% of the token cost back as credits, and withdraw anytime — a step-by-step guide.
- [Models Catalog](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/models-catalog.md): Browse models you can call in your workspace, with pricing, context limits, capabilities, and active-use signals. Show all models lists the full catalog.
- [Tool Use](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/tool-use.md): Define tools, let the model call them, and feed results back. Build agents, function-calling workflows, and structured outputs across every model.
- [Free Tier](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/free-tier.md): Call a curated set of free models through anyrouter/free — no BYOK setup, no credit deduction. 10 requests/day on Free, 1000/day on paid plans.
- [Latest Model Aliases](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/latest-model-aliases.md): Use a "-latest" model id such as google/gemini-flash-latest to always call the newest available model in a family, with automatic fallback when a model is retired or unavailable.
- [Presets](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/presets.md): Create reusable configuration bundles with default models, system prompts, and sampling parameters. Reference them from API requests with @preset syntax.
- [Free-tier Aggregation](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/free-tier-aggregation.md): Combine multiple providers' free API tiers behind one endpoint, with smart key balancing, automatic quota detection, and an opt-in paid fallback.
- [App Attribution](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/app-attribution.md): Attribute your API usage to your app with HTTP-Referer and X-AnyRouter headers and appear in public rankings and analytics.
- [Privacy & Logging Controls](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/privacy-controls.md): Control what AnyRouter retains — request body capture, PII redaction, training opt-out, blocked providers, and data residency.
- [Smart Routing](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/routing.md): How AnyRouter picks an upstream provider for each request — priority order, automatic failover, model aliases, and explicit override controls.
- [How AnyRouter Chooses a Credential](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/credential-selection.md): The order AnyRouter checks your own provider keys, the shared pool, and AnyRouter credits — and what happens when a key is rate limited or fails.
- [AnyRouter Agent](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/anyrouter-agent.md): Free on-site support copilot on anyrouter.dev — ask docs, models, and (after you opt in) your plan and keys without leaving the page.
- [Organizations & Workspaces](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/organizations.md): Invite teammates, set roles, switch between workspaces, and isolate billing per organization.
- [Account Settings](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/account-settings.md): Manage your AnyRouter profile, email addresses, authentication methods, and connected devices.
- [Local Relay — Serve Models From Your Own Machine](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/local-relay.md): Route requests to a model running on your own computer (Apple Foundation Models, Ollama, LM Studio) through your AnyRouter API key, and optionally donate idle capacity to the shared pool for credits.
- [Rate Limits](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/rate-limits.md): AnyRouter's per-IP and per-key rate limits, how tiers are picked, what 429 vs 403 mean, and how to handle them in your client.
- [AI/ML API (BYOK)](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/byok-providers/aimlapi.md): How to create an API key for AI/ML API and add it to AnyRouter via Bring Your Own Key.
- [AI21 (BYOK)](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/byok-providers/ai21.md): How to create an API key for AI21 and add it to AnyRouter via Bring Your Own Key.
- [AIHubMix (BYOK)](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/features/byok-providers/aihubmix.md): How to create an API key for AIHubMix and add it to AnyRouter via Bring Your Own Key.

## MCP

- [AnyRouter MCP Overview](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp.md): Bring AnyRouter into Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and any other MCP-aware client with one URL and OAuth consent.
- [MCP Gateway — connect your tools once](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/gateway.md): Point any MCP client at one URL and get AnyRouter's native tools plus every connected third-party MCP server, with auth managed for you.
- [AnyRouter MCP with Claude Desktop](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/claude-desktop.md): Add the AnyRouter MCP server to Claude Desktop via the built-in Connectors UI, or with a manual mcp-remote bridge.
- [AnyRouter MCP with Claude Code](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/claude-code.md): Add the AnyRouter MCP server to Claude Code (CLI) with one command or by editing .mcp.json.
- [AnyRouter MCP with Cursor](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/cursor.md): Add the AnyRouter MCP server to Cursor via the Settings UI or by editing ~/.cursor/mcp.json.
- [AnyRouter MCP with Windsurf](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/windsurf.md): Add the AnyRouter MCP server to Windsurf via the Cascade Settings UI or by editing ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json.
- [AnyRouter MCP with Cline](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/cline.md): Add the AnyRouter MCP server to Cline (VS Code extension) via the MCP Servers panel or cline_mcp_settings.json.
- [AnyRouter MCP with GitHub Copilot](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/github-copilot.md): Add the AnyRouter MCP server to GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code via .vscode/mcp.json or settings.json.
- [AnyRouter MCP with OpenCode](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/opencode.md): Add the AnyRouter MCP server to OpenCode via a project-local or global opencode.json.
- [AnyRouter MCP with other clients](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/mcp/other-clients.md): Connect any MCP-aware client to AnyRouter using the standard remote HTTP transport, OAuth, or a static API key.

## API Reference

- [API Overview](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/overview.md): Choose the right AnyRouter inference surface — Chat Completions, Messages, Responses, Embeddings — plus catalog and status endpoints.
- [Chat Completions API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/chat-completions.md): POST /api/v1/chat/completions — the OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Send messages, get a completion, across every model in the catalog.
- [Messages API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/messages.md): POST /api/v1/messages — the Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint. Point any Anthropic SDK or Claude Code at AnyRouter by swapping the base URL.
- [Responses API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/responses.md): /api/v1/responses — the OpenAI Responses-compatible lifecycle. Send input, stream or retrieve responses, continue state, and inspect input items.
- [Images API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/images.md): Image generation is not supported. AnyRouter is a text and embeddings API.
- [OCR API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/ocr.md): POST /api/v1/ocr/extract — extract text from images and documents as Markdown, powered by Cloudflare Workers AI.
- [Embeddings API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/embeddings.md): POST /api/v1/embeddings — generate text embeddings for semantic search, clustering, and classification. OpenAI-compatible.
- [Decisions API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/systemone.md): POST /api/v1/decisions — typed decisions. Send state and typed questions; get structured answers. Not chat. POST /api/v1/systemone is the same handler.
- [Models API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/models.md): GET /api/v1/models — list models you can call, plus pricing, context windows, capabilities, and live provider routing. Pass all=1 for the full catalog.
- [Providers API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/providers.md): List the upstream backends AnyRouter can dispatch requests to.
- [Health API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/health.md): GET /api/v1/health — live snapshot with status, checked_at, and per-component health.
- [Management API Keys](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/management-keys.md): Programmatic credentials for managing your AnyRouter account — keys, presets, BYOK, and credits.
- [API Keys](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/keys.md): Inspect, create, update, and delete AnyRouter LLM API keys.
- [Presets API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/presets.md): Create, list, update, and delete reusable preset configurations.
- [OAuth](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/oauth.md): Mint a scoped API key from an existing key (PKCE), or authorize a browser-less device. For "let my users sign in with their AnyRouter account," see the Sign in with AnyRouter guide instead.
- [Credits API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/credits.md): Check the remaining credit balance for your AnyRouter workspace.
- [MCP API Reference](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/mcp.md): JSON-RPC tool catalog, scopes, error shapes, and manual authentication for the AnyRouter MCP server.
- [Network Stats API](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/api-reference/network-stats.md): Public aggregate network analytics — total tokens processed, top models, and activity trends.

## Blog

- [Latest aliases: name a family, always get a live model](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/latest-model-aliases): Models get retired or go down. A -latest alias calls the newest model in a family that is available right now, skips dead ones, and bills the model that answered.
- [Latest 别名：指定模型家族，始终获得可用模型](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/latest-model-aliases): 模型会下线或故障。-latest 别名会调用家族中当前可用的最新模型，跳过不可用的，并按实际作答的模型计费。
- [Alias latest: gọi tên một họ model, luôn có model đang chạy](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/latest-model-aliases): Model có thể bị gỡ hoặc gặp sự cố. Alias -latest gọi model mới nhất đang khả dụng trong họ, bỏ qua model đã chết và tính phí theo model đã trả lời.
- [anyr decision puts structured decisions in your terminal](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/anyr-decision-cli): Run TypeSafe Jev, Fastino GLiNER2.5-Decide, or the anyrouter/decision preset with one native CLI command instead of forcing decision models through a chat agent.

- [Space Bunny Alpha đã miễn phí trên AnyRouter](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/space-bunny-alpha): Bản preview stealth ẩn danh đã ra mắt với context 1M token, reasoning có thể điều chỉnh, đầu vào đa phương tiện và route catalog $0/$0 khi còn cloaked.
- [A shared key pool, and a free-token pool on the other side](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/intro): AnyRouter started as one URL in front of many models. The part that actually matters is the pool: people donate spare provider keys, the gateway routes around them, and everyone else draws a free-token pool instead of hunting for a working key.
- [共享 key 池，另一头是给用户的免费 token 池](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/intro): AnyRouter 一开始只是「一个 URL 打到很多模型」。真正要紧的是池子：有人把闲置的供应商 key 捐进来，网关在这些 key 之间调度，其他人不用自己去找一把还能用的 key，就能从免费 token 池里取用量。
- [Một pool key dùng chung, và một pool token miễn phí phía bên kia](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/intro): AnyRouter bắt đầu như một URL đứng trước nhiều model. Phần quan trọng thật sự là cái pool: người ta góp key nhà cung cấp đang dư, gateway điều phối quanh chúng, và người khác lấy token từ pool miễn phí thay vì tự đi tìm một key còn chạy được.
- [AnyRouter vs OpenRouter: a practical comparison](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/anyrouter-vs-openrouter): Both route one API across many models. AnyRouter is $0-markup on your own keys, runs at the Cloudflare edge, and a $2/mo Go plan ($4 credits) unlocks free models — Free has no monthly credits. Here is the verifiable difference.
- [AnyRouter 对 OpenRouter：实用对比](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/anyrouter-vs-openrouter): 两边都是一个 API 打到很多模型。AnyRouter 在你自己的 key 上 $0 加价，跑在 Cloudflare 边缘，每月 $2 的 Go（$4 额度）解锁免费模型——Free 没有月度额度。下面是能核对的差别。
- [AnyRouter và OpenRouter: so sánh thực tế](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/anyrouter-vs-openrouter): Cả hai route một API qua nhiều model. AnyRouter markup $0 trên key của bạn, chạy ở cạnh Cloudflare, và gói Go $2/tháng ($4 credit) mở model miễn phí — Free không có credit tháng. Đây là khác biệt kiểm chứng được.
- [在 anyrouter.dev 上跑 Claude Code（BYOK、捐 key、anyr claude）](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/anyrouter-zhongzhuan): 官方站是 anyrouter.dev。文档 docs.anyrouter.dev，控制台 dash.anyrouter.dev。Free 没有每月赠送额度。Go 是 $2/月（Polar 卡上扣 $2.63）→ $4 额度。curl setup.sh，然后 anyr claude。ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://anyrouter.dev/api。没有支付宝，也没有微信。

- [Donate a key for Go — no card](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/donate-a-key-for-go): Two ways to Go: pay $2/mo (card charged $2.63, $4 credits) or donate one eligible BYOK key (DeepSeek, Z.ai GLM, Moonshot Kimi). No Alipay or WeChat. Donor cut 5%/8%, capped at $1 per key per UTC day — that $1 is the donor cap, not the Go price.
- [捐一把 key 换 Go，不用绑卡](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/donate-a-key-for-go): 开通 Go 有两条路：付 $2/月（卡上扣 $2.63，$4 额度），或捐一把可用的 BYOK key（DeepSeek、Z.ai GLM、Moonshot Kimi）。没有支付宝，也没有微信。捐赠分成 5%/8%，每把 key 每个 UTC 日上限 $1——这个 $1 是捐赠上限，不是 Go 价格。
- [Góp một key để lấy Go — không cần thẻ](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/donate-a-key-for-go): Hai cách mở Go: trả $2/tháng (thẻ bị trừ $2.63, $4 credit) hoặc góp một key BYOK đủ điều kiện (DeepSeek, Z.ai GLM, Moonshot Kimi). Không Alipay, không WeChat. Chia cho người góp 5%/8%, trần $1 mỗi key mỗi ngày UTC — $1 đó là trần thưởng, không phải giá Go.
- [AnyRouter pricing: Free vs Go (the $1 posts are wrong)](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/anyrouter-pricing-free-vs-go): Older pages still say $1 Go — wrong. Free has no monthly credits; anyrouter/free is 10 req/day. Go is $2/mo ($2.63 charged) → $4. Pro $10 ($11.05) → $20; Pro+ $45 ($47.89) → $100; Max $100 ($105.79) → $300.
- [AnyRouter 定价：Free 对 Go（写 $1 Go 的帖子是错的）](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/anyrouter-pricing-free-vs-go): 旧页还写 $1 Go——错。Free 没有月度额度；anyrouter/free 是每天 10 次。Go 是 $2/月（实收 $2.63）→ $4。Pro $10（$11.05）→ $20；Pro+ $45（$47.89）→ $100；Max $100（$105.79）→ $300。

Free không có credit tháng; anyrouter/free là 10 req/ngày. Go là $2/tháng (trừ $2.63) → $4. Pro $10 ($11.05) → $20; Pro+ $45 ($47.89) → $100; Max $100 ($105.79) → $300.

- [What is AnyRouter? A plain-English guide to AI model routing](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/what-is-anyrouter): An AI model router lets you call many LLMs through one API. Here's what AnyRouter is, why it exists, and whether it's useful for your next project.
- [AnyRouter 是什么？用人话讲 AI 模型路由](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/what-is-anyrouter): AI 模型路由器让你用一个 API 调用很多 LLM。下面讲 AnyRouter 是什么、为什么存在、对你下一个项目有没有用。
- [AnyRouter là gì? Giải thích routing model AI bằng tiếng thường](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/what-is-anyrouter): Router model AI cho phép gọi nhiều LLM qua một API. Đây là AnyRouter là gì, vì sao tồn tại, và có ích cho dự án tiếp theo của bạn không.
- [HTTP 429 and 503 errors when calling AI APIs: what they mean and how to fix them](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/anyrouter-429-error-fix): If you've hit a 429 Too Many Requests or 503 Service Unavailable on AnyRouter or another AI gateway, the cause is almost always rate limiting or upstream overload. Here are the practical fixes.

- [Calling providers directly vs. routing through one gateway](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/direct-provider-vs-gateway): Call OpenAI, Anthropic, and every other provider directly and you manage a key, an SDK, and an audit trail per provider. Route the same calls through one gateway and you manage one of each — at the cost of an extra hop. Here's the honest trade-off on auth, SDKs, failover, billing, audit logs, and switching cost.
- [直连供应商 vs. 经一个网关路由](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/direct-provider-vs-gateway): 直接打 OpenAI、Anthropic 和每个其他供应商，你就要为每个供应商管一把 key、一套 SDK、一份审计轨迹。把同样的调用经一个网关走，每样只管一份——代价是多一跳。下面是 auth、SDK、failover、账单、审计日志和切换成本的老实权衡。
- [Gọi nhà cung cấp trực tiếp vs. route qua một gateway](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/direct-provider-vs-gateway): Gọi OpenAI, Anthropic và mọi nhà cung cấp khác trực tiếp thì bạn quản lý một key, một SDK, và một audit trail mỗi nhà. Route cùng những call đó qua một gateway thì bạn quản lý mỗi thứ một cái — đổi lấy một hop thêm. Đây là đánh đổi thẳng thắn về auth, SDK, failover, billing, audit log, và chi phí chuyển.
- [An LLM API without vendor lock-in](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/llm-api-without-vendor-lock-in): Vendor lock-in with an LLM API usually isn't the model — it's the proprietary client shape you built against. Standing on the standard OpenAI-compatible surface (plus Anthropic /messages and OpenAI /responses) keeps the exit door open: the same code you write also works pointed straight at the origin provider.
- [一份没有供应商锁定的 LLM API](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/llm-api-without-vendor-lock-in): LLM API 的锁定通常不是模型本身——而是你对着写的那套专有客户端形状。站在标准兼容 OpenAI 的表面上（外加 Anthropic /messages 和 OpenAI /responses），出口一直开着：你写的同一份代码，直接指向源供应商也能跑。
- [API LLM không bị vendor lock-in](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/llm-api-without-vendor-lock-in): Lock-in với API LLM thường không phải mô hình — mà là hình dạng client độc quyền bạn đã dựng. Đứng trên bề mặt chuẩn tương thích OpenAI (cộng Anthropic /messages và OpenAI /responses) giữ cửa thoát mở: cùng code bạn viết cũng chạy khi trỏ thẳng vào nhà cung cấp gốc.
- [How automatic failover works in an LLM gateway](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/llm-gateway-latency-and-failover): A single provider call has a single point of failure: one rate limit, one outage, one bad deploy on their end, and your request fails. Here's the actual mechanism AnyRouter uses to route around that — circuit breakers, escalating cooldowns, and a fallback chain — and why the extra hop barely registers next to model generation time.
- [LLM 网关里的自动 failover 怎么工作](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/llm-gateway-latency-and-failover): 一次直连供应商调用只有一个失败点：一次限流、一次宕机、他们那边一次糟糕的发布，你的请求就失败。下面是 AnyRouter 实际用来绕开的机制——断路器、逐级冷却、以及回退链——以及为什么多出来的那一跳，相对模型生成时间几乎感觉不到。
- [Failover tự động trong LLM gateway hoạt động thế nào](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/llm-gateway-latency-and-failover): Một call nhà cung cấp đơn có một điểm thất bại: một rate limit, một outage, một deploy xấu phía họ, và request của bạn fail. Đây là cơ chế AnyRouter thực sự dùng để đi vòng — circuit breaker, cooldown leo thang, và chuỗi fallback — và vì sao hop thêm gần như không đáng kể so với thời gian generate của mô hình.
- [Building an LLM gateway on Cloudflare Workers](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/building-an-llm-gateway-on-cloudflare-workers): AnyRouter runs as a set of Cloudflare Workers, not a long-running server. That constrains the design in specific ways — a 128MB memory ceiling that rules out buffering responses, a 3MiB script cap that forced a multi-Worker split, and a hard rule that every upstream call goes through Cloudflare's AI Gateway. Here's what that architecture actually looks like.
- [在 Cloudflare Workers 上做 LLM 网关](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/building-an-llm-gateway-on-cloudflare-workers): AnyRouter 跑在一组 Cloudflare Worker 上，不是常驻服务器。这套设计被具体限制卡住：128MB 内存上限禁止缓冲整段响应，3MiB 脚本上限逼出多 Worker 拆分，以及硬规则——每条上游调用都必须走 Cloudflare AI Gateway。下面是这套架构实际长什么样。
- [Xây LLM gateway trên Cloudflare Workers](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/building-an-llm-gateway-on-cloudflare-workers): AnyRouter chạy trên một cụm Cloudflare Worker, không phải server sống lâu. Thiết kế bị ràng buộc cụ thể: trần 128MB RAM cấm buffer cả response, trần script 3MiB buộc tách nhiều Worker, và quy tắc cứng — mọi cuộc gọi upstream đều đi qua Cloudflare AI Gateway. Đây là kiến trúc thực tế.

A unified MCP gateway puts them behind one endpoint with one auth flow, and connecting to AnyRouter's is free.
- [把 MCP 工具统一到一个免费网关后面](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/unify-mcp-gateway-free): 当你不断加 MCP 服务器——搜索、代码、数据、自己的内部工具——每个客户端都要自己的配置和凭证。统一 MCP 网关把它们放在一个端点、一套鉴权后面，连上 AnyRouter 的网关是免费的。
- [Thống nhất công cụ MCP sau một gateway miễn phí](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/unify-mcp-gateway-free): Khi bạn thêm MCP server — tìm kiếm, code, data, công cụ nội bộ — mỗi client cần config và credential riêng. MCP gateway thống nhất đặt chúng sau một endpoint với một luồng auth, và kết nối tới gateway của AnyRouter thì miễn phí.
- [OpenRouter alternative: what to compare before you switch](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/openrouter-alternative): Looking for an OpenRouter alternative? Compare markup, bring-your-own-keys, billing, and lock-in — then see where AnyRouter lands. No invented benchmarks.
- [OpenRouter 替代：换网关前该比什么](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/zh/openrouter-alternative): 在找 OpenRouter 替代？比加价、自带 key、账单和锁定——再看 AnyRouter 落在哪。没有编造的榜单。
- [Thay thế OpenRouter: so gì trước khi chuyển](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/vi/openrouter-alternative): Đang tìm thay thế OpenRouter? So markup, bring-your-own-keys, billing, và lock-in — rồi xem AnyRouter đứng ở đâu. Không bịa benchmark.

## Model releases

- [Model releases](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases): Changelog of models added or disabled, newest first.
- [GPT-6.1 Sol](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-30): OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol joins the catalog BYOK-only through OpenAI — 1.05M-token context, 128K max output, image input, and adjustable reasoning at $2 / $10 per million input / output tokens.
- [Latest aliases: name a model family, always get a live model](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-30-latest-aliases): Send google/gemini-flash-latest, anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest and 17 other -latest ids. AnyRouter calls the newest model in that family that is available right now, skips retired ones, and bills the model that answered.
- [Liquid d1](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-30-liquid-d1): Liquid AI's first decision model joins the Decisions family: send state and typed questions, get calibrated probabilities back with zero generated tokens. Free on Liquid's API with your own Liquid key.
- [Solar Decide](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-30-solar-decide): Upstage's Solar Decide joins the Decisions family: send state and typed questions, get structured answers instead of chat text, with a 524,288-token context window at $0.05 per million input tokens.
- [3 models disabled](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-30-disabled): The only upstream no longer publishes inclusionai/ling-2.6-1t (live /models 2026-09-30); the Ling-3.0 family replaces it. (#3687) Plus 2 more.
- [Claude Sonnet 5.5](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-29): Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 joins the catalog — the direct upgrade to Claude Sonnet 5, at the same $2 / $10 per million input / output tokens, with adaptive thinking on by default, 1M-token context, 128K max output, and vision input.

Novita retires deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash at 16:00 UTC on Oct 9, 2026 — both Novita hops now carry the date and point at V4.1 Flash.
- [Step 5 Preview](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-29-step-5): StepFun's next-generation flagship base model joins the catalog BYOK-only on AIHubMix — 1M-token context, 64K max output, text/image/video input, and adjustable reasoning at $1.08 / $3.0888 per million input / output tokens.

- [Kev 4B](https://anyrouter.dev/blog/releases/2026-09-26): Kev 4B is a small open-weight decision model — a LoRA adapter and pointer head on Qwen3.5-4B-Base. It answers typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text, on the same native `/v1/decisions` contract as the rest of the family.

It always reasons with adjustable effort over a 1M-token context window, served $0 via OpenRouter, Nous, and OpenCode Zen platform hops.

## Changelog

- [Changelog](https://anyrouter.dev/changelog): Release summaries and product updates, newest first.
- [AnyRouter 1.6: name a model family, always get a live model](https://anyrouter.dev/changelog/1.6.0): Send a -latest id and AnyRouter calls the newest available model in that family. This release also adds new models, in-place BYOK key replacement, a read-only analytics scope for management keys, and a redesigned site.

## Developer resources

Machine-readable surfaces at predictable URLs:

- [OpenAPI spec](https://anyrouter.dev/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 for the whole `/api/v1` surface (also at https://anyrouter.dev/openapi.yaml).
- [Docs index (markdown)](https://anyrouter.dev/docs.md): this documentation set as one markdown page.
- [Model catalog (markdown)](https://anyrouter.dev/models.md): every model with pricing, context window, and links to `/model/<id>.md` datasheets.
- [Apps directory (markdown)](https://anyrouter.dev/data/apps.md): curated agent apps and their model routing.
- [Data pages (markdown)](https://anyrouter.dev/data.md): leaderboards and benchmarks; each child page has a `.md` twin.
- [Health](https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/health): live status JSON for uptime checks.
- [Contact](https://anyrouter.dev/contact): support, privacy, and security email channels.

Official CLI (`anyr`) — native binary, no npm:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://anyrouter.dev/setup.sh | bash
anyr claude   # launch Claude Code through AnyRouter
anyr login
```

- [CLI docs](https://anyrouter.dev/docs/cli.md): full command reference for the launcher, profiles, delegation, and usage queries.

## Optional

- [Full docs bundle](https://anyrouter.dev/llms-full.txt): Every doc concatenated into a single file.
